items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and authorize only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required before any rights request, public data display, affiliate or advertising use, alert expansion, or launch decision.

Fleet compliance and data-quality disposition: compliance is conditional, with 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; failed or unknown sites require site-specific remediation or evidence before exposure or monetization. Analytics is conditional because source permissions or collector errors remain; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Revenue is evidence_needed: the 2026-09-21 Amazon export reports $4.92 aggregate commission under an aggregate row that cannot be assigned to a site. Preserve it as unattributed and make no site-revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal-lift claims. SEO and analytics metrics remain operating indicators only.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task is closable because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

Data-use review decisions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert permissions, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price terms, and affiliate/advertising rights. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory.

Private-site decision: retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked and private. Both are scaffold/parked, analytics is not configured, and compliance reachability currently fails with network errors; audience, disclosures, consent, monetization, and operational health are unknown. Exact launch decision: no launch or monetization change. Next evidence action: attach dated execution-owner verification, reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and explicit launch-decision evidence. No DNS, credential, analytics, monetization, deployment, or configuration change is authorized.

Retain containment-only work. Continue existing launch-readiness evidence, site-specific compliance remediation, security evidence, attribution reconciliation, parked-site verification, and existing measurement. Close no launch-readiness task until its required evidence is attached and reviewed. Do not create duplicate proposals, change requests, deployments, monetization expansion, dependencies, telemetry, spend, requeues, or external outreach.
